title: Authentication failures and access denials
actions: Confirm the affected identity, application and authentication provider.
Check recent token, certificate or access-policy changes.
Review failed-login volume and source patterns before changing access controls.
safeguards: Do not reset credentials or revoke access without human approval.

title: Database connectivity and transaction failures
actions: Check database availability, connection-pool saturation and recent deployments.
Inspect slow queries, lock contention and retry rates.
Validate recovery using a read-only health query before closing the incident.
safeguards: Require approval before failover, restart or transaction termination.

title: Network timeout and reachability investigation
actions: Confirm whether the failure is isolated to one service, zone or dependency.
Check DNS resolution, endpoint health and recent firewall or routing changes.
Compare error rates and latency with the previous healthy period.
safeguards: Require approval before routing, firewall or load-balancer changes.

title: Storage capacity and HDFS failures
actions: Check capacity, inode usage, replication status and affected volumes.
Identify rapid growth, failed jobs or unavailable storage nodes.
Preserve evidence and confirm redundancy before cleanup or rebalancing.
safeguards: Never delete data automatically; cleanup requires human approval.

title: Application error and service degradation
actions: Correlate the error with deployments, configuration changes and dependency health.
Review exception frequency, affected endpoints and customer impact.
Validate a rollback or restart plan and its success criteria.
safeguards: Rollback and restart actions require human approval.
